description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different variants of the DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) model, measured by MRR@10, as a function of the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)", is a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", is a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0. The plot compares four models: "DPR w/o query" (black solid line), "DPR w/ corpus expansion" (red solid line with circular markers), "DPR w/ document expansion" (green solid line with triangular markers), and "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" (blue solid line with star markers). The "DPR w/o query" model shows a constant MRR@10 of approximately 34.2 across all query counts. The "DPR w/ corpus expansion" model starts at an MRR@10 of about 35.2 and increases to a peak of approximately 35.8 at 6 queries, then slightly decreases to about 35.7 at 10 queries. The "DPR w/ document expansion" model begins at an MRR@10 of approximately 34.7, remains relatively stable around 34.8, and ends at about 34.7. The "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" model starts at an MRR@10 of about 34.6, rises to a peak of approximately 35.1 at 2 queries, then declines to about 34.4 at 10 queries.
